response.sql:
WITH maj AS (
  SELECT m.major_id, m.department, COUNT(*) AS member_count,
         CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member) AS share
  FROM member mem
  JOIN major m ON mem.link_to_major = m.major_id
  GROUP BY m.major_id, m.department
),
dept AS (
  SELECT department, AVG(share) AS avg_share
  FROM maj
  GROUP BY department
)
SELECT maj.major_id, maj.department, maj.member_count, maj.share,
       maj.share - dept.avg_share AS diff_above_avg
FROM maj
JOIN dept ON maj.department = dept.department
WHERE maj.share > dept.avg_share
ORDER BY diff_above_avg DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The department average is taken only over majors that have at least one member (majors with zero members do not appear in the per-major shares).
The total number of members is COUNT(*) over the member table, including members with no link_to_major or no matching major.

alternatives.interpretation: Department average includes all majors in the department, counting majors with no members as share 0.
alternatives.sql:
WITH total AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM member
),
maj AS (
  SELECT m.major_id, m.department, COUNT(mem.member_id) AS member_count,
         CAST(COUNT(mem.member_id) AS REAL) / (SELECT n FROM total) AS share
  FROM major m
  LEFT JOIN member mem ON mem.link_to_major = m.major_id
  GROUP BY m.major_id, m.department
),
dept AS (
  SELECT department, AVG(share) AS avg_share
  FROM maj
  GROUP BY department
)
SELECT maj.major_id, maj.department, maj.member_count, maj.share,
       maj.share - dept.avg_share AS diff_above_avg
FROM maj
JOIN dept ON maj.department = dept.department
WHERE maj.member_count > 0 AND maj.share > dept.avg_share
ORDER BY diff_above_avg DESC
LIMIT 10;
